recent_story_cards.conflict: The newlywed is pressured to share her honeymoon with her mother-in-law while the groom protects the two expensive bookings he made for himself and his mother.

recent_story_cards.conflict: The sister wants their mother's name restored while her brother argues that sponsorship money matters more than the history attached to the company name.

recent_story_cards.conflict: The diner must protect herself while the chef and her boyfriend dismiss a severe allergy as entertainment for the restaurant's livestream.
recent_story_cards.payoff: The dinner was free because Ben had already paid with her credibility.

recent_story_cards.title: The Allergy Test Served at Their Anniversary
recent_story_cards.twist: The boyfriend secured their place by describing her allergy as exaggerated and claiming she would prove it for a free year of meals.

recent_story_cards.twist: The boyfriend marked every item belonging to him as essential while selecting only her possessions for the curbside sale.
